about_the_game:
Add-on for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii allowing you to change into Kazuma Kiryu's iconic "Dragon of Dojima" outfit.

■ Special Outfit: Kazuma Kiryu (Dragon of Dojima)

*Please be aware that this additional content is the same at that was distributed as a bonus for signing up to SEGA's newsletter.
*You must own a copy of Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii in order to use this add-on content. Please update the game by downloading the latest patch and updating before using it.
*The “Kazuma Kiryu Special Outfit” will be available after the ability to change outfits is unlocked in Chapter 2 of the main game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Blood, Intense Violence, Sexual Themes, Strong Language, and Use of Tobacco and Alcohol.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 1909 (Build18363.1350)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470,3.2GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 1200, 3.1GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650,4GB or AMD Radeon RX 560,4GB or Intel Arc A380,6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Low@30FPS w/Balanced FSR1.0,requires a CPU with supports the AVX and SSE4.2 instruction set
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 1909 (Build18363.1350)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790,3.6GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 3.2GHz

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060,6GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700,8GB or Intel Arc A750,8GB
